criteria.requirement: Add immutable natsort.records.FieldSortSpec(key,alg=ns.DEFAULT,reverse=False,missing="last") and multisorted(iterable,fields). Fields are ordered highest priority first; each uses its own existing natsort algorithm and direction. Keep stable ties and full original records, consume a one-shot input once and never mutate caller lists. Treat None as missing with explicit first/last/error positions independent of reverse; reject invalid/empty specs and propagate getter errors. Default nested-key and natsorted behavior remain unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
